q1.a: They can book 24/7 via the website, WhatsApp, Instagram DM, and QR code. Conflict checking is automatic.

q2.a: A WhatsApp message is sent to the customer at set times before the appointment (e.g. 24 hours, 2 hours before). It reduces your no-show rate by up to 60%.

q3.q: What does the customer score system do?
q3.a: Every customer is assigned a score from 0-100 based on visit frequency, spending, and loyalty. You can recognize your valuable customers and offer them priority booking and special deals.

tour.welcomeBody: Take a few minutes to configure your business details, booking link and automatic messages — so your customers get a smooth experience from day one.
tour.introBody: Every section here feeds either your booking page or the messages sent to your customers. Let's take a quick look; then fill in the fields and press Save at the bottom.
tour.basicInfoBody: Business name, phone and address. The address/location appears in booking confirmation and reminder messages — if you leave it blank, no map/location link shows in messages. Your logo appears on your booking page and in emails. Set the correct time zone; all appointment times are calculated from it.
tour.bookingLinkBody: siriplan.com/r/your-business — the link you give your customers. You can download the QR code and display it at your venue. From here you can turn online booking fully on or off and choose which services can be booked online. On the Pro/Business plan, 'Website Settings' in the left menu lets you switch this page to Website Mode and customize it like a mini website with your own colours, cover image and category photos (Classic or Showcase template).
tour.workingHoursBody: Your weekly opening/closing times. Online booking slots are shown ONLY within this range. If you leave a day closed, no online bookings can be made that day.
tour.integrationsBody: Your Instagram/TikTok handles appear as icons on your booking page. For Telegram notifications: search @siriplan_bot in the Telegram app, open the bot and press 'Start' — the bot gives you a Chat ID number. Paste that number into the Telegram field and save; from then on you get an instant phone notification for every new or cancelled appointment.
tour.autoMessageBody: The text of your booking confirmation, cancellation, change and reminder messages. You edit each tab (confirm / cancel / revise / reminder) separately. Variables like {musteri}, {salon}, {tarih} are filled in automatically. Pick a ready template or write your own — if left blank, the default text is sent.
tour.onlineBookingBody: Set the appointment slot interval here: customers see times in 15, 30 or 60-minute steps on your booking page — match it to your service length. Automatic confirmation of bookings is on by default on every plan; turn the checkbox off and you approve each request yourself and get a notification.
tour.whatsappNotifBody: Turn automatic WhatsApp messages on or off and set how many hours before the appointment the reminder goes out. While off, your customers receive no automatic WhatsApp messages. For SMS notifications you need to enter your own SMS provider details.
tour.staffPermissionsBody: Here you set what each staff member can see and do in the panel (customer phone numbers, reports, cancelling appointments, etc.). When sending an invite you also pick a role (Staff / Manager) plus fine-tuning. Staff can view their own permissions on the My Account page but cannot change them.
tour.doneBody: Press the Save button — it stays pinned to the bottom of the page — as you fill in each section; your details are only stored when you save. For stock management, the calendar, dashboard personalization and everything else, check the User Guide. You can reopen this tour any time via 'Restart the setup tour' under the Settings heading.
tour.welcomeStaffBody: Take 1 minute to see where things are in the panel and what your permissions are.
tour.staffIntroBody: You manage your appointments, calendar and (if permitted) customer records from this panel. Let's take a quick tour.
tour.staffNavBody: Use the left menu (the bottom menu button on mobile) to reach Calendar, Appointments and Customers. Only the sections available to you are shown.
tour.staffPermsBody: The business owner decides what you can see and do in the panel. If you can't see a section or perform an action, that permission is off — you can view your full permission list on the 'My Account' page. Contact the owner for changes.
tour.staffAccountBody: Update your name, phone and panel language on the 'My Account' page. To change your password, use the 'Forgot password' link on the login screen.
tour.staffDoneBody: Check the User Guide for anything you get stuck on. You can restart this tour any time from the My Account page.

baslangic.title: 1. Quick Start & Account Setup
baslangic.intro: Digitalize your salon in 5 minutes with SiriPlan Appointment & Business Management System. Stop paper-pen chaos, forgotten appointments, and empty chairs!

steps.title: Register for Free
steps.desc: Open your 14-day free trial account with your business name, email, and phone number. No credit card required.

steps.title: Fill Business Information
steps.desc: Go to Settings → General. Select your sector (Hairdresser, Beauty Salon, Nail Art, Spa, etc.), set your working days/hours, and upload your logo and cover photo.

giris.title: 2. Login Flow: Admin and Staff Login
giris.intro: SiriPlan supports multi-user and role architecture:

items.label: Business Owner / Admin Login:
items.desc: Log in with registered Email or Phone + password. Full access to all financial data, settings, and reports.

items.label: Staff Login:
items.desc: Admin sends invitation link via Staff → Invite. Staff registers with their email/phone to access dashboard. Staff only see their own appointments and customer calendar, not business turnover or financials.

panel.title: 3. Dashboard Personalization
panel.intro: The main dashboard screen has a widget-based flexible structure:

items.label: Drag & Drop Widgets:
items.desc: Click "Personalize" at the top right to drag and rearrange widget cards.

items.label: Show / Hide Cards:
items.desc: Hide cards you don't need by clicking the eye icon, and pin your favorites.

items.label: User-Specific Memory:
items.desc: View preferences are saved for each user individually (hiding a card for staff doesn't affect admin).

items.label: Colour Theme:
items.desc: Pick a colour theme that fits your business from the palette icon at the bottom of the sidebar — Rose Pink, Classic Blue, Ocean Blue, Nature Green, Night Mode, Sunset Orange, and Midnight Purple. Your choice is remembered on this device.

hizmetler.title: 4. Define Your Services
hizmetler.intro: Upload all treatments and services you offer to the system:
steps: Go to Services on the left menu.
Click + New Service.
Fill details: enter service name, category, duration (blocks calendar slot), and price.
Press Save.

personel.title: 5. Add Staff & Permissions
personel.intro: Set up calendar and roles for each professional in your team:
steps: Go to Staff on the left menu.
Click + Add / Invite Staff.
Select staff name, phone, work days, and calendar display color.
Assign Role: Admin (Full access) or Staff (Can only see own appointments).
Salary & Commission: Set Base Salary and % Commission rate from staff details.

blocks.heading: Click to Book Instantly:
blocks.text: When you click a vacant slot or staff column on the calendar, the New Appointment dialog opens with Date, Time, and Staff pre-filled.

blocks.heading: Customize & Filter Calendar:
blocks.text: View calendar by Day, Week, or Month. Compare all staff columns side-by-side or focus on a single staff member's schedule.

adisyon.title: 7. Ticket & Receipt Printing
adisyon.intro: Professional receipts and billing are available for completed appointments:
steps: Click on the appointment and press the "Adisyon" (Receipt) button.
Receipt content displays: Business Logo, Name, Address, Phone, Services, Tip, Total Amount, and Payment Method.
Use "Print" in top right to send to a thermal printer directly or save as PDF.

You can also reach it from 3 shortcuts without opening the detail page: the notification shown when you mark an appointment "Completed", the "Adisyon" button under a completed appointment card in the Appointments list, or the receipt icon next to a past visit row on the customer detail page.

vitrin.title: 8. Business Website & Online Booking (/r/[slug])
vitrin.intro: A dedicated booking page is provided for 24/7 online customer scheduling and salon showcase:

items.label: Custom Web Address:
items.desc: A elegant link like siriplan.com/r/your-business-name is assigned to your business.

items.label: Upload Gallery & Images:
items.desc: Upload Logo, Cover, and Gallery photos from Settings → General to display beautifully on your public page.

items.label: Online Booking Wizard:
items.desc: Customers browse, select Service → Staff → Date/Time, and book in seconds.

whatsapp.title: 9. Automated WhatsApp / SMS Notifications
whatsapp.intro: The most practical way to prevent client no-shows!

items.label: Settings → Notifications:
items.desc: Activate WhatsApp, SMS, or Telegram integrations.

items.label: Auto Message Types:
items.desc: Booking Confirmation, Reminders (2h or 1d before), and Cancellations/Changes send automatically.

items.label: Message Tone:
items.desc: Choose Warm, Formal, or Short styles depending on your salon's concept.

telegram.title: 10. Staff Notification Channels (Telegram, WhatsApp, In-App)
telegram.intro: When a new appointment or request comes in, you and your staff can be notified through several channels at once:
steps: Search @siriplan_bot in Telegram, open the bot, and click "Start".
Copy the numeric Chat ID provided by the bot.
Paste it in the "Telegram Chat ID" field in Settings → Notifications on your SiriPlan panel.

For WhatsApp notifications, fill in the "WhatsApp Number" field in Settings (business-wide) or Staff → [name]. Note: per Meta's rules it only delivers if this number has messaged your business within the last 24 hours — connect Telegram too so you never miss one.
While the panel is open (desktop or phone), a sound and notification fire automatically for new appointments/requests; toggle the sound from the bell icon in the sidebar/menu.
Choose which channels you want to be notified on using the checkboxes in Settings → Integrations or the Staff detail page — every channel starts on, turn off any you don't want.

kampanya.title: 11. Bulk WhatsApp Campaigns
kampanya.intro: Send bulk messages to your clients to fill empty slots or promote campaigns:
steps: Go to Campaigns tab and click + New Campaign.
Write the text using dynamic variables: Hello {{musteri_adi}}, {{salon_adi}}...
Filter the desired segment (e.g. inactive for last 30 days) and start sending.

abonelik.title: 12. Subscription & Plan Management
paragraphs: Plans: Starter, Pro, and Business plans are fixed and transparent. No requests for quote or waiting for agents. Every account starts with a 14-day free trial.
Plan Details: View your current plan, limits, and billing history under Settings → Subscription.
Your subscription is linked to SiriPlan and managed independently of app stores. For questions about upgrades or billing, contact support: info@bysirius.com · WhatsApp +90 535 503 26 34.

sadakat.title: 13. CRM & Loyalty Points
sadakat.intro: Increase customer retention by using loyalty points feature:

items.label: Customer History:
items.desc: Review past bookings, receipts, and custom notes from the customer details page.

items.label: Loyalty Points:
items.desc: Award points automatically on completed appointments. Configure which services award points under Services tab.

items.label: Cash Management:
items.desc: Track expenses like rent, products, and utilities in Income/Expense to monitor net profit.

items.label: Staff Payroll & Commission:
items.desc: Calculate monthly payroll in Staff → Salary page: Base Salary + (Service Volume x Commission %) + Tips. Book as expense in cash book with a single click once paid.

items.label: VAT Calculation:
items.desc: Enter your rate and turn it on from Settings → VAT Calculation (on by default for new businesses). Update it from the same screen whenever the legal rate changes — no rate is hard-coded. When on, the "Estimated VAT" card is calculated on both this page and Reports, assuming that month's income includes VAT.

items.label: Detailed Reports:
items.desc: Analyze daily/weekly appointments, revenue charts, top services, and staff performance.

items.label: Excel/CSV Export & Import:
items.desc: Upload your old customer list via Excel on the Data Migration page, or export your database as JSON/CSV.

mic.introBody: To book appointments by voice, your browser needs access to the microphone. Audio is captured only while you speak and is never stored.
mic.introHint: When you tap "Continue", your browser will ask for permission — choose "Allow" in that prompt.
mic.blockedBody: Your browser is blocking the microphone for this site. Follow the steps below and try again.

nativeApp: Phone Settings → Apps → SiriPlan → Permissions → Microphone → Allow.
If "Microphone" isn't in the list, this build of the app doesn't support audio capture — use voice booking in a browser (Chrome/Safari) on siriplan.com instead.
After granting it, return to the app and tap "Try again".
desktop: Click the lock or settings icon on the left of the address bar.
Reload the page and press "Try again".
android: Tap the lock icon in the address bar → "Permissions" → "Microphone" → Allow.
If that doesn't work: Phone Settings → Apps → your browser → Permissions → Microphone → Allow.
Return to this page and tap "Try again".
ios: Open iPhone Settings → scroll down and pick your browser (Safari or Chrome).
Return to this page and tap "Try again".

settingsPage.legalSectionDesc: All copyright and intellectual property rights to this software are registered by BY Sirius Group Ai & Technology Co Ltd. and protected under the Berne Convention and FSEK provisions.
settingsPage.accountDeletionDesc: In compliance with mobile application store policies (App Store & Play Store) and data privacy regulations, you can permanently delete your account and all associated data. This action cannot be undone.
settingsPage.billingCardDesc: Plan, usage limits and payment management
settingsPage.logoHint: PNG, JPG or WebP — up to 2MB. Shown on your booking page.
settingsPage.taxNumberPlaceholder: Tax No (10 digits) or National ID (11 digits)
settingsPage.timezoneHint: Working hours, availability and appointment notifications are calculated based on this time zone.
settingsPage.locationHint: Find your business on Google Maps, copy the link via Share and paste it here — the automatic appointment confirmation messages show customers the correct location they can reach by tapping this link. If left blank, a map link is generated automatically from your address.
settingsPage.bookingLinkDesc: Share this link in your social media bio or with customers via WhatsApp. Customers can see open slots and book themselves; they are automatically added to your customer list along with the privacy notice they accept.
settingsPage.qrShareHint: You can print and display it in your salon; customers can scan it with their phone to reach your booking page directly.
settingsPage.websiteUpsellTitle: Turn your booking page into a website →
settingsPage.websiteUpsellDesc: A sales-boosting business page with a color palette, cover photo, service categories and photos — on your existing booking link, with no extra address.
settingsPage.bookingLinkFailed: Your booking link could not be created, please contact the support team.
settingsPage.socialIconHint: If website mode is on, it appears as an icon on your booking page.
settingsPage.whatsappNumberNotifyHint: New appointment notifications are also sent to this number. Per Meta's rules, WhatsApp notifications only deliver if this number has messaged your business within the last 24 hours — connect Telegram too (Settings → Notifications) so you never miss one.
settingsPage.telegramHint: When a new appointment is created (online or manually), an instant Telegram notification is sent here.
settingsPage.telegramHelpSummary: How do I find my Chat ID?
settingsPage.telegramStep1: Search @siriplan_bot in the Telegram app, open the bot and press 'Start'.
settingsPage.telegramStep2: The bot will send you a Chat ID number.
settingsPage.telegramStep3: Paste that number above and save — you'll now get a notification for every appointment.
settingsPage.otherChannelsDesc: All channels start on; turn off any you don't want.
settingsPage.autoMessageDesc: These are the texts you send manually from your own WhatsApp when the 'Send WhatsApp message to customer' box is checked on the appointment screens (New Appointment / Quick Appointment) and via the 'Send Manual Message' button in appointment details. Date and time are filled in automatically for each appointment.
settingsPage.autoMessageWarning: This channel is NOT connected to Meta — the message opens in the WhatsApp on your own phone and you send it, so you can edit the text however you like. It is a different channel from the Meta automatic messages in the "WhatsApp Notification Settings" section below — if both are on, the customer may receive the same information twice, so keeping one off is recommended. If you turn Meta automatic messages off entirely, this manual channel becomes your only notification method.
settingsPage.templatePromoWarning: These messages are appointment notifications. Adding any campaign, discount or promotional wording turns them into "commercial electronic messages", triggering İYS registration and explicit customer consent obligations. Use the Campaigns section for promotions.
settingsPage.presetSicakText: Dear {musteri}, your appointment at {salon} on {tarih} at {saat} has been created. If you have any questions, you can reach us at this number. See you soon! 💫
settingsPage.presetResmiText: Dear {musteri}, your appointment at {salon} on {tarih} at {saat} has been recorded. For your information.
settingsPage.presetHizmetliText: Hi {musteri}, your {hizmet} appointment on {tarih} {saat} with {personel} at {salon} has been created. We're expecting you!
settingsPage.onlineBookingDesc: Appointments from your booking link (/r/...) are auto-confirmed by default, added to the calendar, and a confirmation message is sent to the customer.
settingsPage.autoConfirmDesc: Available on every plan, off by default: appointments from your booking link are held in a "pending" queue until you approve them, and you get a notification for every new request. Turn it on and appointments are confirmed immediately, added to the calendar, and the customer gets a WhatsApp confirmation message.
settingsPage.autoConfirmFreeText: Appointments from your booking link are auto-confirmed and added to the calendar.
settingsPage.slotIntervalDesc: The time intervals visitors see when choosing an appointment (15 minutes, 30 minutes or hourly).
settingsPage.currencyDesc: The currency used in the inventory, income & expenses, payroll and commission screens (if you have customers paying abroad or in foreign currency).
settingsPage.whatsappNotifDesc: A custom note appended to the reminder and cancellation messages sent automatically as the appointment time approaches.
settingsPage.autoWhatsappReminderDesc: If you turn this off, automatic reminder messages for the duration selected below are not sent.
settingsPage.metaEventsLabel: For which events should an automatic WhatsApp message be sent via Meta?
settingsPage.metaEventsDesc: These messages are sent automatically from Sirius's shared WhatsApp Business number using a Meta-approved template. If you turn an event off, no automatic message is sent for it — you can send it manually from your own WhatsApp using the "Send WhatsApp message to customer" box on the appointment screen. Don't keep both on, or the customer will receive the same information twice.
settingsPage.reminderOffsetLabel: How many hours before the appointment should the reminder be sent?
settingsPage.reminderOffsetDesc: You can select only one duration — selecting one disables the others.
settingsPage.metaTemplatesDesc: From the approved template variants registered in your Meta WhatsApp Business panel, choose the one that applies for each case.
settingsPage.metaTemplatesFootnote: The text of these templates is pre-approved in your Meta WhatsApp Business panel, so it can't be edited here — you can only choose which variant is used. The previews above are an approximate example of the parameters that will be sent (name, date, time, etc.); the exact text depends on the approved template in your Meta panel.
settingsPage.smsNotifDesc: You can also send appointment confirmation, reminder and cancellation notifications by SMS. To do so, open an account with an SMS provider (Netgsm, VatanSMS or İletimerkezi) and enter your API details here.
settingsPage.smsEnabledDesc: When off, the "Send SMS" buttons in appointment details don't work.
settingsPage.smsSenderHint: The header you had approved by the operator from your provider panel — SMS is rejected if sent without approval.
settingsPage.smsCostText: Roughly 0.08–0.20 TRY per SMS (depending on package size) — you need to buy a credit package from the provider's site; there is no fixed monthly fee.
settingsPage.waBusinessConnDesc: Appointment confirmation/reminder/cancellation messages are sent automatically from SiriPlan's own WhatsApp line — you don't need to do anything for that. The connection below is only so that marketing messages sent from the Campaigns module and automatic replies to incoming messages go from your own WhatsApp Business number.
settingsPage.waHowToText: Connect a WhatsApp Business account via Meta Business Suite, then copy the permanent access token and phone number ID from Meta for Developers > your app > WhatsApp > API Setup. While these fields are empty, your campaigns can't be sent over the WhatsApp channel (you can use the SMS channel).
settingsPage.metaBusinessConnDesc: To send automatic AI replies to messages on your Instagram and Facebook page, enter your Page's access token and ID below. If your Instagram account is linked to your Facebook Page, one connection covers both channels. While these fields are empty, incoming DMs get no automatic reply.
settingsPage.metaHowToText: Create a "Business" type app on Meta for Developers (developers.facebook.com), add the Messenger and Instagram products. Connect your Facebook Page, then copy the Page Access Token and Page ID (under Page Settings > Page Info) here. No extra step is needed if your Instagram account is linked to the same Page.
settingsPage.kdvDesc: Enter your rate to see the estimated VAT amount in Income & Expense and Reports pages — update it here whenever the legal rate changes. The income amounts you enter are assumed to include VAT.
settingsPage.kdvEnabledDesc: When on, the estimated VAT amount is shown on the Income & Expense and Reports pages. On by default for new businesses.
settingsPage.kdvRateHint: The standard rate in Türkiye is 20%.
settingsPage.kvkkDesc: The privacy notice shown to your customers when they book. If left blank, the platform's default text is used.
settingsPage.workingHoursDesc: Leave the open/close times blank for closed days
settingsPage.legalBody: All source code, designs, and flows of the SiriPlan platform are protected under FSEK and the Berne Convention. A fully compliant infrastructure with Store (App Store / Play Store) policies and GDPR/KVKK data privacy is provided.
settingsPage.dangerZoneBody: When you delete your account, your login credentials and all staff access of your business will be permanently closed, and your subscription will be cancelled. Your customer records will not be deleted, but personal identifying details (name, phone, email) will be anonymized; appointment and revenue history will continue to be kept statistically for the legal accounting retention period. This action cannot be undone.

securityPage.metaDescription: SiriPlan vulnerability reporting and responsible disclosure policy.
securityPage.intro: We take the security of our users' data seriously. If you have identified a security vulnerability, we ask you to report it to us following the rules below.
securityPage.reportP: Send your findings, together with the steps needed to reproduce the issue, to info@bysirius.com. Where possible, attach a screenshot or a short recording. For machine-readable information, see /.well-known/security.txt.
rulesItems: Test only on data belonging to your own account; do not access, modify or delete other users' data.
Avoid tests that would cause service disruption (DDoS, brute force, spam).
Do not disclose the vulnerability publicly before reporting it to us and allowing a reasonable time to fix it.
Do not retain any data you obtain or share it with third parties.
securityPage.harborP: We will not take legal action against researchers who act in good faith and follow these rules. This page is not a commitment to a bug bounty program and no specific response or remediation time is guaranteed; we aim to review reports within a reasonable time.
